name: DEVIL'S WAY 2
detailed_description:
You start as an ordinary person living in a quiet village. However, escalating schizophrenic episodes are turning your life into a living hell. The village is no longer a familiar place—it has transformed into a terrifying nightmare. Now, you must use your wit and courage to survive and escape this nightmare.

Key Features

Atmosphere Filled with Fear
Deserted and dark village roads, detailed environmental designs, and chilling sound effects will send shivers down your spine.

Limited Resource Management
In the village, the only aid you have is a limited supply of bullets and a single weapon. Use your resources wisely to survive.

Psychological Tension and Horror
Due to your schizophrenic episodes, you begin to see questions on the signs along the village paths. But will these questions lead you to the right path or to an even greater danger?

Survival Against Monsters
Fight against terrifying monsters—be they a product of your schizophrenic episodes or reality—that you can hardly tell apart.

Deep Story and Realistic Characters
Experience a story where reality and delusions intertwine, told from the perspective of a character battling a mental illness.

DEVIL'S WAY 2 promises to deliver an unforgettable horror experience to players with its constantly tense atmosphere, compelling story, and challenging survival mechanics.
